sources: https://www.cpwshop.com/camping/jackson-lake-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.page?parkID=50028 (map GIS layer: every Lakeside site's type, length, coordinates)
cpwshop campsiteDetails pages for all 62 Lakeside sites, read 2026-10-27

hookups.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails for every Lakeside site: the 57 'Electric' sites and 1 'Electric - ADA' site give 'Electricity Hookup: 20/30/50', no water or sewer hookup listed; the 4 'Tent' sites (049-052) none. Read 2026-10-27

values.note: 58 electric sites (one ADA, 035HD) and 4 tent/hammock sites (49-52, 15 ft). Electric-site vehicle lengths: 40 ft at 44, 45-60 ft at 7, 25-35 ft at 7. 41 pull-through. CPW marks 24 of the sites 'Lakefront'.

sites.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails for all 62 Lakeside sites (Site Type, Maximum Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, Proximity to Water) + brochure ('Hammock camping is permitted in tent sites #49-52 in Lakeside Campground'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Shower houses and flush toilets close for the off season (reopening the first weekend of April); vault toilets then. The dump station is on the west side of the park, for campers.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/jackson-lake-state-park/jackson-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Amenities include: ... Toilets, Showers, Electrical hook-ups, Dump station, Water'; 'a camper services building with showers, drinking water and toilets'; alert 'Shower houses and flush toilets will remain closed until the first weekend of April. Vault toilets are available.') + brochure ('A dump station is located on the west side of Jackson Lake State Park and is available to any guest with a valid camping permit/reservation'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Lakeside, Cove and Pelican stay open through the off season (October-March); winter amenities are vault toilets only.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/jackson-lake-state-park/jackson-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Open year-round'; 'Camping is available year-round. During the off season (October through March), the following campgrounds remain open: Lakeside, Cove and Pelican'; 'Winter amenities: Vault toilets') + cpwshop: every Lakeside, Pelican and Cove site 'Status: Open year round.' and priced for Jan 12, 2027, read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead of arrival. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon. Display a vehicle pass (kiosk near the entrance station). No transfers to another site after arrival.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/jackson-lake-state-park/jackson-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at Jackson Lake State Park ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance of your arrival date'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period') + brochure ('All campsites are available by reservation') + cpwshop site pages ('RESTRICTION: Upon arrival at your reserved site, there will be NO TRANSFERS to another site'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Electric sites $36 a night in January and in June, a Saturday the same. Plus tax, CPW's per-stay reservation fee, and a daily vehicle pass ($10-$15) or an annual Colorado state parks pass.

fees.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails with arrival dates Tue Jan 12, 2027 and Sat Jun 19, 2027 (electric sites: '$36.00 /Per Night') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/jackson-lake-state-park/jackson-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Single campsite (max 6 occupants) 1 Night $28 - $36'; 'Daily Vehicle Pass: $10-$15'), read 2026-10-27

note: Southernmost electric loop on Jackson Lake's west shore; the lake-side (east) row of sites sits right on the shoreline per the CPW campground map. Reservoir draws down for irrigation by mid/late summer. --Claude
